title: Make Classic Patents physics and completion claims executable instead of checkbox-complete
description: Reality-check finding: README and roadmap language presents all 79 records and multi-domain simulators as complete FrankenSim WASM-backed artifacts, while runtime code explicitly supports TS_FALLBACK and HONEST_PLACEHOLDER provenance and many telemetry methods remain host calculations. The master and deep integration TODOs mark broad domain work and thousands of visual-weave ideas complete even where host formulas or display-only behavior remain. Build an executable coverage ledger from the 79-record registry: archival status, visual dispatcher, stepped kernel identity, runtime provenance, shared-bus participation, equation/claim coupling, and tested no-claim boundary. Rewrite README and roadmap claims from that ledger and add a gate that fails on coverage drift. Host mathematics may remain, but it must not be described as a FrankenSim crate or WASM step.
acceptance_criteria: A generated/tested 79-row coverage manifest distinguishes pinned PDF, reviewed ledger, edition, visual, TS fallback, generic WASM, patent-specific WASM, and honest placeholder; README catalogue counts and physics wording derive from or are tested against the manifest; roadmap checkboxes cannot pass solely because a host formula or decorative visual exists; tests instantiate available WASM surfaces and prove provenance labels fail closed; stale contradictory transport or integration docs are retired or clearly scoped without deleting files; verification commands and live smoke evidence are recorded.

title: Complete the Linotype archival publication contract or stop claiming 79 of 79 complete records
description: Reality-check finding: the registry has 79 unique patents and every record has a PDF URL, but us-313224-mergenthaler-linotype is the exception to the README claim that every record has a reviewed transcription and archival edition. It points to a source-pdf-text-layer and has no archivalEdition. Complete the provenance, reviewed ledger, continuous hand-authored edition, claim synchronization, figure previews, term annotations, parallel readings, and publication-contract tests under the repository doctrine; or change public documentation to explicitly disclose partial coverage until that work is reviewed. Never promote machine text-layer output to reviewed evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Pinned PDF digest agrees across provenance, record, edition, and reviewed ledger; ledger has complete ordered page markers and human-review metadata; edition validates and pins all text/claims/figures to the ledger; paragraph parallel readings and required figure files exist; the manual edition publication contract and focused Linotype tests pass; allPatents reports 79 reviewed-transcription assets and 79 archival editions before README says every record is complete.

title: Serialize native patent scene preparation
description: Deadlock-finder-and-fixer audit found SceneKit resource preparation running on a second renderer against a scene concurrently owned and animated by SCNView. Use the owning renderer's asynchronous preparation API and generation-fence completion.
close_reason: Removed cross-thread SCNRenderer traversal of a live SceneKit graph; use the owning SCNView preparation path and fence completion by patent and scene identity. Simulator and Catalyst builds pass.
